verdict.rationale: Kong provides decK, a dedicated CLI/tool explicitly built for API Lifecycle Automation (APIOps) to sync declarative config from CI, plus kongctl as another CLI for Konnect/Gateway management, and DB-less/declarative deployment mode is a core supported architecture. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g. GitHub Actions integration) and independent third-party corroboration of GitOps workflows in production.
